text: 印尼周二已公布首批熊猫债发行的条款。作为东南亚最大的经济体，该国正试图在汇率波动和财政挑战的背景下实现融资渠道多元化。根据债券发行文件，该国拟发行三年期和五年期熊猫债，初步发行规模合计最高可达70亿元人民币。该文件显示，印尼已获准于未来两年在中国银行间债券市场发行总额至多达300亿元人民币的熊猫债。“投资者对我们发行的中国债券一直反应积极，”印尼财政部长普尔巴亚·尤迪·萨德瓦周二在简报会上表示。（彭博）
text_en: Indonesia announced the terms of its first panda bond issuance on Tuesday. As Southeast Asia's largest economy, the country is seeking to diversify funding sources amid exchange rate volatility and fiscal challenges. According to the bond issuance documents, Indonesia plans to issue three-year and five-year panda bonds with an initial combined size of up to 7 billion yuan. The documents show Indonesia has been approved to issue up to 30 billion yuan in panda bonds on China's interbank bond market over the next two years. 'Investors have been very positive about our Chinese bond issuance,' Indonesian Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa said at a briefing on Tuesday. (Bloomberg)
